name: @epoch/access-projection
description: Epoch Access Projection kernel (W041) — least-privilege projections over the canonical W036 solution/delivery state. Projection POLICY is data: typed, versioned, sealed ProjectionPolicy records bind (principal role OR agent-task class) x object class -> allowed actions -> minimum-necessary field allowlists -> evidence/commercial/supplier scope filters -> redaction rules; swapping a policy revision changes the projection with ZERO code change. Evaluation is TWO STAGE, strictly ordered: the W009 authorization decision point answers allow/deny first (the kernel CONSUMES sealed decisions and their request digests — it never re-implements authorization), then the projection stage computes the visible subset through a zod-schema-driven field walk. Projections carry the SAME object id and content digest as the canonical record (projections never mint identities); every non-released field becomes a typed RedactionMarker (never a silent drop); every projection decision emits a sealed, content-addressed ProjectionAuditRecord. NO persistence, NO UI, NO provider vocabulary.
